title: theMisc
description: Adds a personal memo, glowing death drops, and a few simple features.
body:
給這東西命名好難.... 總之是一些寫來自用的雜用小功能集：

- 死亡時遺物發光耐燃留存15分鐘
- **空手時**快速蹲站：取出個人筆記
- **持物時**快速蹲站：展示手上物品
- **附近有掉落物時，看向腳下**並快速蹲站：提示附近掉落物

----------------------------------
- Death drops glow, are fireproof, and despawn time is extended to 15 minutes.
- Consecutive sneaks can trigger the following actions: 
  - **Empty-handed**: Take out your personal memo.
  - **While holding an item**: Display the held item in chat.
  - **While looking down (if nearby drops)**: Highlight nearby dropped items.
